chapter: New York, Philadelphia and Harlem nightlife
title: Broadway shows and managing Sidney Bechet's affairs
summary: He recounts shows including Tambourines to Glory and Clash By Night, and managing Bechet's business.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I began playing more in New York and then I did Tambourines to Glory with Langston.* I did Clash By Night on Broadway with Tallulah Bankhead. I did another thing called The Last House on the Left with Irish Owen ...he was a playwrite and a producer. The show was so bad, until the actors asked him to cancel it. It closed in Boston.

But by this time now my name was getting around and I was friends with Sidney Bechet and managing some of his affairs. It's a funny thing, you know, Dan, musicians like for me to manage their business. They like...you know, they like the idea that I have, you know, of really trying to look at it. For example, like the day the lady worked for me, came in here, talking about, you know, the leader. I know she don't know anything about it. She's trying to tell me /that she's sharp. Yeah, she's sharp, but she's just like all the other people that walk in a store. What do I know about Celsius and 5 Celsius and 75 Fahrenheit? Because of the fact that when I was taught the basics of life, like pounds, a quarter of a pound, a quart, you know what I mean, a mile, and etcetera. These are the basic things with which I was equipped as a child. So this is part of me.
